_readme: Draft Order Games: the commissioner makes the league compete for draft order every year. Fill in one entry per year: 'competition' (short name), 'description' (how it was played), 'winner' (a manager id from data/managers.json, e.g. 'ryan-nussdorfer', or null) and optional 'notes'. The actual draft order is pulled automatically from the ESPN/Sleeper draft data; don't type it here. Rebuild with: python3 scripts/build_all.py
